messages:
kyle: Heads-up — incoming support ticket from Acme asking for a streaming chat endpoint that can do function/tool calls and emit structured JSON frames for downstream ingestion. They want to process events as they arrive and trigger their toolchain in real time. Ticket snippet below.

kyle: ticket excerpt:

---
Customer: acme-corp
Use-case: customer conversation -> stream tokens to UI while also getting out-of-band function call intents and a final structured payload per turn so their analytics pipeline can ingest it.
Requirements: low tail latency, deterministic JSON frames (schema), backpressure safe, Node SDK support.
---

kyle: suggested minimal example of the streaming wire format they expect:

```
data: {"type":"delta","content":"Here is your"}

data: {"type":"fn_call","name":"lookup_account","args":{"email":"alice@acme.com"}}

data: {"type":"delta","content":" account details..."}

data: {"type":"final","structured":{"intent":"update_billing","fields":{"account_id":1234}}}

[EOF]
```

kyle: They also asked that the structured frames be schema-validated (they'll register schemas on their side).

dana: How big is this deal? Is Acme on Dedicated or Hosted? Timeline?

kyle: Acme is enterprise (hosted today, exploring Dedicated later). They marked it as high business impact and are willing to pilot if we can provide an initial implementation within ~6 weeks.

maria: Quick triage/questions: 1) Is this covered by our current streaming + fncall work? 2) Do we already have a recommended frame format for structured outputs or is this new? 3) What are minimal launch criteria so we can scope properly?

jess: Technical notes: we already have streaming text + fncall prototypes, but we don't have a first-class structured-frame contract. The main choices: a) interleaved JSON frames (like Kyle pasted) with a newline-delimited prefix (compatible with existing text event stream), b) embedded markers inside token stream (harder for consumers). I'd push for newline-delimited JSON frames with explicit `type` to keep parity with existing SSE.

jess: Also need to decide about semantics: should function call frames be authoritative (we pause text deltas while fn_call happens) or optimistic (emit deltas concurrently)? Backpressure and ordering matter for downstream tools.

triage-bot: tag auto-applied: api-streaming, fncall, structured-output

maria: Proposal (initial scope):
- Accept newline-delimited JSON event frames with types: `delta`, `fn_call`, `final_structured`.
- Support streaming fn_call events with `name` and `args` (JSON).
- Provide schema validation hooks (server-side opt-in) and clear SDK helpers to parse frames.
- Launch as P2 backlog item with pilot offer to Acme.

maria: Suggested minimal launch criteria (must-haves):
1) Spec doc for wire format + examples (Node + Python).
2) Server-side validation test harness — ability to opt-in to schema checks and fail fast.
3) SDK streaming helpers that yield typed events and handle reconnection/backoff.
4) Perf verification: no more than 10% regression on p50 latency for typical chat workloads.
5) Rollout plan: feature flag, canary to 1-2 customers, automatic fallback to non-structured streaming if schema fails.

dana: Acme will provide prompt set and sample schemas and can be our canary if engineering agrees. They expect an SLA on ordering (must be deterministic across retries).

jess: Rough estimate: baseline impl (newline JSON frames + fn_call) + SDK helpers = 3 dev sprints (engineer + infra). Schema validation + tests = additional sprint. Work depends on runtime changes to ensure atomic emission of fn_call frames and consistency under retries.

alex: I can coordinate the pilot and get Acme to sign up for a feature-flagged pilot. I'll collect their schema registry examples and test prompts.

maria: OK — action plan: 1) Add to backlog as P2 (owner: maria). 2) Eng lead: jess to write high-level technical approach and an initial design doc by EOD Tues. 3) Support (alex) to collect customer artifacts this week. 4) Product to finalize launch criteria and update roadmap slice next planning sync.

maria: I'll open a GH issues epic and link ticket. Putting this on the board now. :rocket:
